title: VERIFY: Can you text to get a free Target gift card?
description: One post going around claims you can text "Target" to 83361 to get a free gift card to the store. We contacted Target and the company says it's a scam.

asr.full_text: Facebook friends probably share a lot of things that show up on your news feed, but is it all real? Our Verify team checks one post that has been popping up online. It claims that If you text TARGET to 83361, you'll get a free gift card to the store! Of course we contacted target. The company says do not click or respond any ads offering free gift cards. They are scams. Some have even said that after texting the number, Facebook posts that they did not write started popping up in random Facebook groups advertising this offer. Well, we compared those posts. They are all carbon copies of each other, always ending with a smiling or winking emoji. So, we can verify this post definitely false it is a scam designed to steal your private information shouldn't be surprised do you have something you want our verify team to look into email verify Cajun comm or reach out to us on Twitter with the hashtag khou verifier
